_comment: WAN 2.7 I2V workflow — ComfyUI Partner Nodes (CPD-79). ComfyUI 0.18.5+ required. SCAFFOLD: validate against actual ComfyUI Partner Node schema on pod. Requires dfy+ plan tier. Image must be uploaded to the ComfyUI pod via /upload/image before submission — pass the returned filename as imageFilename. Auth: ComfyUI pod must be logged in with COMFYUI_API_KEY. Patches applied by runpod.js: node['1'].inputs.image, node['2'].inputs.{prompt,negative_prompt,resolution,ratio,duration,seed}

inputs.prompt: the subject moves naturally in the scene
inputs.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted, watermark, text, logo
